decisions.reason: The manual workstation has only been mentioned on the website, never featured, which suggests modest results against aspiration. It may overlap with the newer LC400 cabin, but a large firm's slack lets it carry a low-cost niche product another year.
It has kept its own dedicated page for two years, which signals it meets aspirations within the firm's core coding and marking line, so there is no shortfall to trigger search.
Its stable dedicated presentation in both years and its fit with the established high-resolution inkjet portfolio suggest performance at or above aspiration.
Featuring it on the home page shows strong management commitment and early results above aspiration for a strategic growth line.
It is a newly promoted product with its own page and launch messaging, and slack allows the firm to wait for results that are still uncertain.
The trade fair award supports its legitimacy, and its niche results are still uncertain, which slack can absorb, even though it is only mentioned rather than prominently featured.
